name: HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_IDS_
description: The HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_IDS table is used to capture all additional identifiers associated to a Party. For example, if the customer would like to capture the Drivers License or the passport information for a party, this information would be stored as an entry in the HZ_ADDTNL_PARTY_IDS table with the PARTY_IDENTIFIRER_VALUE column storing the Drivers license / passport information and PARTY_IDENTIFIER_TYPE will specify either FDRIVERS_LICENSE or PASSPORT.

columns.name: PARTY_IDENTIFIER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier. Primary Key. System generated.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party Identifier

columns.name: PARTY_IDENTIFIER_TYPE
columns.description: Identifier type for this ID. Values are defined in TYPE_CODE of HZ_NAME_AND_ID_TYPE_B. The party type should be consistent with the party type that the PARTY_IDENTIFIER_TYPE can be applied to.

columns.name: PARTY_IDENTIFIER_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the Identifier for the Party

columns.name: STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: Record Status Flag used to soft delete entity. Possible values are 'A' (active), 'I' (inactive), 'D' (logically deleted), and 'M' (merged).

columns.name: ACTUAL_CONTENT_SOURCE
columns.description: Source system that provides this name. Default with USER_ENTERED. Foreign key to HZ_ORIG_SYSTEMS_B

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: TCA Who column

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: Foreign key to FND_TERRITORY. TERRITORY_CODE.From UI, COUNTRY and STATE should be displayed based on geography setup. Used for certain types of identifiers such as Passports or Driving licenses.

columns.name: STATE_PROVINCE
columns.description: From UI, COUNTRY and STATE should be displayed based on geography setup. Used for certain types of identifiers such as Passports or Driving licenses

columns.name: ISSUING_AUTHORITY_NAME
columns.description: If ISSUING_AUTHORITY_PARTY_ID is not null, check foreign key. Otherwise, store ISSUING_AUTHORITY_NAME. Either of these should be populated

columns.name: ISSUING_AUTHORITY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: If ISSUING_AUTHORITY_PARTY_ID is not null, check foreign key. Otherwise, store ISSUING_AUTHORITY_NAME. Either of these should be populated

columns.name: ISSUE_DATE
columns.description: Date in which the Identifier was issued. It may be NULL as it does not apply to all types of identifiers

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: Expiration date for the identifier. It may be NULL as it does not apply to all types of identifiers.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Free text comment/description
